channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small open weights under Apache 2.0
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab publishes the weights for Inkling 2 Small, a 594B-parameter MoE with 17B active per token, a week after its hosted-only debut; the NVFP4 checkpoint needs roughly 500GB of GPU memory, so it is a server-class open-weight release rather than a laptop model.

item.title: Inkling 2 Small weights land on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab's 594B MoE (17B active per token) shipped its full weights on November 12 under Apache 2.0, with NVFP4 and MXFP8 checkpoints and local-inference support via SGLang, vLLM and Unsloth.

item.title: Berkeley and Nvidia open-source coding-agent tools that program industrial robots
item.description: Berkeley and Nvidia released open tools (Graph-as-Policy, RoboSimStudio, VABAR) that let teams of AI coding agents write, simulate, and validate industrial robot programs without collecting robot training data.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Sets a Franchise Launch Record: Repositioning a 20-Year-Old Classic
item.description: Blizzard says Forever is the biggest WoW launch ever by peak concurrency and returning players, with 8.86 million characters made in beta and the first raids opening December 9.

item.title: Arete-27B-GGUF: Nous's value-tuned 27B model as a local LLM
item.description: AtomicChat published GGUF builds of Nous Research's Arete-27B, a value-tuned Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune, in quants from 13.6 GB to 28.6 GB with per-file speed and quality measurements.

item.title: TI adds agentic AI to CCStudio, with MCP-driven device data and a migration skill
item.description: Texas Instruments added agentic AI to its CCStudio IDE: MCP servers feed device data and the debugger straight to coding agents, and a device migration skill claims to cut MCU porting from months to days.

item.title: Local LLM With LFM3: 13 Steps, 1 GB, 75 Min [2026]
item.description: Step-by-step walkthrough for running Liquid AI's new LFM3-1.7B locally at 4-bit in about 1 GB, with tool calling and a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

item.title: GSQ and RCO: the non-uniform quantization now sitting in GGUF files
item.description: A new per-tensor quantization recipe pairs GSQ's learned low-bit grids with RCO's budget-aware allocation, squeezing Qwen3.8-Flash-Next into a 75.8 GB GGUF that matches the base model on AIME25.

item.title: llama-cpp-pascal: 50-70% faster inference on old Pascal GPUs
item.description: A llama.cpp fork with hand-written CUDA kernels for pre-tensor-core Pascal cards (GTX 1070 era): compressed-KV flash attention and ternary matmuls, claiming a 27B model at 96K context on an 8GB card.

item.title: ThinkingCap Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GGUF quants land
item.description: GGUF quants of the ThinkingCap finetune of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, which keeps the base model's answer quality while reasoning in far fewer tokens; Q4_K_M recommended at 113 GB, with Q6_K and Q8_0 options.

item.title: Berkeley open-sources a harness for agents that build robot programs
item.description: UC Berkeley releases Graph-as-Policy, a harness letting coding agents write, simulate in Isaac and revise robot control programs, alongside an industrial-task benchmark.

item.title: On-device AI and small language models: what changed in October and November 2026
item.description: Small models keep shrinking: Taobao open-sourced the 173MB MNN-Pocket-0.3B, Gemini Nano now runs on 140M devices, and on-device inference tooling keeps improving.

item.title: AI Coding Harness: 28 Agents Compared for 2026
item.description: A fresh comparison of 28 coding-agent harnesses against public benchmarks, prices and release data, including OpenCode v2, Claude Code and Codex.

item.title: ZCode: Z.ai's open-source agentic IDE for GLM-5.2, benchmarked against Cursor
item.description: Z.ai's free desktop agentic IDE runs multi-agent Goals instead of prompts, steers from a phone via Telegram/WeChat, and just added a plugin system; its MIT-licensed GLM-5.2 model ranks second globally on Code Arena.

item.title: Code Copilot Team v2.0.0: open-source harness that enforces coding-agent standards
item.description: Open-source orchestration harness v2.0.0 turns coding-agent rules into enforced runtime hooks across Claude Code, Pi, Codex, Cursor and more, with verification gates and health checks before code lands.

item.title: Season of Discovery's community response is what made Blizzard build WoW Forever
item.description: Blizzard designer Josh Greenfield told Bloomberg that Season of Discovery's community response is what convinced leadership to greenlight a permanent Classic+ game, and that Northshire Abbey became the tech demo that won the team over.

item.title: Blizzard reveals what made it finally pull the trigger on WoW Forever
item.description: In a Bloomberg interview, Josh Greenfield says Season of Discovery's reception is what convinced Blizzard to build a permanent Classic+; the Forever pitch had been floating since before 2019's Classic launch. IGN's early review is very positive.

item.title: Microsoft open-sources Agensh, a leaderless harness for 1,024 coding agents
item.description: Microsoft Research released Agensh under MIT: a decentralized multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator, scaled to 1,024 concurrent coding agents on hard ProgramBench tasks.

item.title: WoW Forever launch hub: live Nov 4, first hotfixes land
item.description: Live launch hub tracking WoW Forever since its Nov 4 debut: the first Nov 5 hotfixes fixing NPC spawns, vendors and Plainsrunning stacking, plus launch guides and the Dec 9 raid roadmap.

item.title: Axolotl 0.21.1 review: YAML-first fine-tuning, with caveats
item.description: Current review of Axolotl's YAML-driven fine-tuning tool: LoRA, QLoRA, DPO and GRPO from one config, GGUF export in 0.21.1, and the telemetry-on-by-default catch to watch for.

item.title: Agentic dev on an Android tablet: Termux as the raw terminal
item.description: Field notes from doing real agentic coding on an Android tablet: skip the slick mobile harness apps, run the agent in Termux with a proper shell, no root needed.

item.title: Rapid-MLX 1.0: local LLM server for Apple Silicon, updated Nov 6
item.description: Apache-2.0 local inference server for Apple Silicon with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs; v1.0.2 (Nov 6) unloads an idle model while the local API stays up, and it already ships LFM3 models.

item.title: CIQ, MariaDB and Harness all rebuilt their platforms for agents as first-class users
item.description: Three vendors in one week shipped agent-facing control surfaces: typed MCP tools, permission tiers set at startup, and audit trails that follow the agent, not just the human.

item.title: Roll20 retires its legacy tabletop: Jumpgate becomes the only engine for new games
item.description: Roll20's Jumpgate engine becomes the sole option for newly created games, with 93% of active games already on it; existing legacy-tabletop games stay available unchanged.

item.title: PFN open-weights PLaMo 3 Translate, a translation LLM that runs offline in four sizes
item.description: Preferred Networks released PLaMo 3 Translate as open weights in 0.8B, 2B, 8B and 31B sizes covering 53 languages; the smallest model was shown translating in real time on a phone in airplane mode, with GGUF and MLX builds for local inference.

item.title: The Agent Harness, Explained: what Microsoft shipped and how to build on it in Python
item.description: A hands-on walkthrough of Microsoft Agent Framework's stable Python/.NET harness — planning, memory, approvals, and telemetry in one call — with a working night-shift ops agent built on it and runnable code.

item.title: Blizzard reveals what finally pulled the trigger on WoW Forever
item.description: IGN interview: Season of Discovery's response convinced leadership to green-light a permanent Classic+ branch, with Northshire Abbey as the tech demo that won them over.

item.title: PFN releases open-weight PLaMo 3 Translate for on-device translation
item.description: Preferred Networks open-sourced translation LLMs in 0.8B to 31B sizes built to run offline on phones and local servers across 53 languages; free for outfits under ¥1B annual revenue.

item.title: WoW Forever launch OT: the community's running thread
item.description: ResetEra's official launch thread for WoW Forever, tracking the new Classic+ branch's launch, Skyborne race, rebalanced classes and separate continuity as players get hands-on.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches today, and its lead designer says the team had to unlearn modern WoW
item.description: Forever is live with 1,000+ new quests, rebalanced classes and a new lighting engine, level cap held at 60, after the largest beta in WoW history.

item.title: Unsloth Shrinks Qwen3.8-Flash-Next to 74.5 GB for Local Coding Agents
item.description: Unsloth's Dynamic V3.1 GGUF quants bring the 125B MoE Qwen3.8-Flash-Next down to 74.5 GB, fitting local coding-agent runs on high-memory workstations.

item.title: Codein v2.2.8 hardens Termux agent recovery on Android
item.description: Android AI workspace Codein ships v2.2.8, hardening durable-run recovery for its Termux agent room so local AI coding sessions survive interruptions; v2.2.7 added the local bridge, model routing, and browser tools.

item.title: Agent8088: open-source harness to help small local LLMs finish long tasks
item.description: Palindrome Research Labs shipped Agent8088, an MIT-licensed open-source agent harness with 59 built-in tools, sub-agents and memory, aimed at helping small local models complete long, complex tasks more reliably.

item.title: WoW Forever UK launch time: 11pm on November 4
item.description: Blizzard's Classic+ goes live worldwide at a single moment, 3pm Pacific, which is 11pm UK time on November 4, included with a standard WoW subscription.

item.title: Dataiku Headless brings governed data work into coding agents
item.description: Dataiku Headless lets developers build and modify governed data pipelines, models and dashboards from the coding agent they already use, with its Cobuild agent doing the Dataiku-side work behind the scenes.

item.title: Codein v2.2.7 Turns Android Into a More Powerful Local AI Coding Workspace
item.description: Codein v2.2.7 adds a local Termux bridge, model routing, and browser tools to its Android AI coding app, letting an agent run approved commands on-device without root.

item.title: Qwen3.6-35b-a3b on 5060ti using Ollama for Hermes
item.description: A 5060 Ti owner works through getting Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to 120K context in Ollama: flash attention plus a q8_0 KV cache, with llama-swap as the VRAM-friendly alternative.

item.title: TwIL-8B: 8.8B Model Claims 93% of Frontier Coding Score
item.description: webAI's open-weight 8.8B reasoning model, post-trained from IBM Granite 4.2, claims near-frontier math and coding scores with a 5 GB Q4_K_M GGUF, though the numbers are the vendor's own and the license is non-commercial.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches as Blizzard's third permanent branch of Azeroth
item.description: Launch-day look at Forever as a permanent third WoW branch rather than a season: 1,000+ new quests, four new zones, the Skyborne race, the account-wide Legacy System, and Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit raids unlocking Dec 9.

item.title: llama.cpp v0.9.0 and ggml 0.29.0: native FP8, multi-node tensor parallelism
item.description: llama.cpp tags v0.9.0 on ggml 0.29.0, adding a native FP8 E4M3 tensor type, a flash-attention variant for multi-sequence serving, and initial multi-node tensor parallelism over NCCL.
